scope: Five main models and supporting analyses reported in the current paper; frozen prepared-input reproduction.

information.historical: Expand history at month boundaries; exclude the entire forecast month.
information.validation: Core count models and joint scales use fixed pre-April 2024 history; Elo uses successive month-start snapshots.
information.holdout: All fits, calibration, counts and ratings frozen before October 1; no October updates.
information.update_comparison: Historical period only; read counts before each event and update after it.
information.identifier_linkage: The two frozen inputs use the same player-surrogate mapping; source mapping is excluded.

joint.search: Base and six settings, halving or doubling one scale at a time.

scoring.primary: Equal-tournament mean of match log loss (natural logarithms).
scoring.calibration_bins: Ten equal-width bins on [0,1], final bin includes 1.
scoring.gain: Reference loss minus model loss; positive favors model.
scoring.stored_precision: Historical forecast probabilities and losses are independently rounded to six decimals; October uses full precision. Weight sensitivity uses full precision and reconciles rounding.

uncertainty.historical: Moving blocks of four calendar months, without wrapping; draw ceil(number of months/4) blocks with replacement; do not truncate the final block. Weight represented tournaments equally.
uncertainty.october: Resample all 396 tournaments independently; indicative intervals conditional on fitted models.
uncertainty.endpoints: Sorted replicates at zero-based indices 125 and 4875. Existing reversed contrasts reverse signs and endpoints; direct gains can differ by one order statistic.
uncertainty.limits: Pointwise intervals omit selection uncertainty. October resampling omits repeated-player and shared-fit dependence.

history_depth.type: Exploratory subgroup analysis of unchanged forecasts
history_depth.counts: Prior eligible appearances only; outcome-independent; both overall and current-archetype counts; freeze before month, including October.
history_depth.resampling: Use common draws from the full calendar/event set. Preserve group-empty months/events; report empty-support replicates.
history_depth.interpretation: Groups can contain different tournaments. Gains are not additive, causal experience effects or tests of between-group differences.
history_depth.both_unseen_tolerance: One stored probability unit (1e-6) plus floating-point tolerance.

weight_sensitivity.selection: Lowest match-weighted April–June validation loss with fixed pre-April fit; ties prefer nearest one, then smaller weight.
weight_sensitivity.timing: Write selection before loading October or scoring evaluation periods.
weight_sensitivity.fixed: Keep pair smoothing and original overall-record implementation unchanged.
weight_sensitivity.checks: Weight 0 reproduces pair forecasts; weight 1 reproduces overall forecasts; removing October target outcomes leaves every October forecast unchanged.

recalibration.method: Two-parameter logistic recalibration of saved probabilities; frozen for later historical and October evaluation.

elo.updates: Batch event update using pre-event ratings; read month-start snapshots for scored forecasts; exclude October outcomes.
